Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 04 November 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Batangas and Laguna.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Pampanga, Bataan, Zambales and Tarlac within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte, Bulakan, Obando, Meycauayan, Marilao, Santa Maria, Bocaue, Angat) and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Gabaldon) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
